# Climato

> Climato, by Faircode, is an all-in-one weather forecast companion app: live local conditions, global city search, Skye (an AI Weather Assistant), Favorites, and Nearby Explorer. Free on iOS and Android.

## Pages

- [Home](https://climato-peach.vercel.app/): What Climato does, its main features (Skye AI assistant, city search, Nearby Explorer), and download links for iOS and Android.
- [Privacy Policy](https://climato-peach.vercel.app/privacy): How Climato collects, uses, and protects user data.
- [Terms of Service](https://climato-peach.vercel.app/terms): Terms governing use of the Climato app.

## Notes

- Climato is developed by Faircode (https://faircodetech.com).
- Available on the App Store and Google Play under the name "Climato".
